# Rack fan and sensor cabling

<!-- Generated by make check from part.toml. Edit part.toml, not this file. -->

| | |
| --- | --- |
| ID | `rack-fan-harness` |
| Category | fabricated |

Off-the-shelf parts only, nothing crimped. The exhaust bank plugs into QUADRO
output 1 through three chained Noctua Y-cables (from the fan boxes), on the fans' own
200 mm leads plus the included 30 cm extensions where needed. The intake bank, under
the floor about the cabinet height away, gets one standard 4-pin PWM extension of
about 1 m (or two chained 60 cm ones) from QUADRO output 2 down a rear corner post,
then three Y-cables at the floor. The exhaust sensor reaches on its own 70 cm lead.
For the one-time setup: a 9-pin internal USB header to USB-A adapter cable. Lengths are set
once the cabinet and the controller position are known. Route along the cabinet
frame with ties, clear of every rotor, with slack for opening the door if the
intake fans sit on it.
